scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:ui
scripts.dev: npm run build && (npm run watch:main & npm run watch:ui)
scripts.sync:skill: cp reference/core/*.md reference/platform/*.md reference/output/*.md skill/references/ && cp reference/lens/_TEMPLATE.md skill/references/lens-template.md && echo synced
scripts.check:neutral: ! grep -rniE 'literacy|tier [123]' reference/core/ reference/platform/ reference/output/ && echo 'library is domain-neutral'
